The Local Government Unit of Candelaria, Quezon joins the nation in this celebration. Caring for the planet can no longer be delayed. We need to take part and make informed choices and intentional actions by building greener and more sustainable habits.
As Robert Swan said:
“The greatest threat to our planet is the belief that someone else will save it.”
This Earth Month, let us be reminded that we are part of an intricate, fragile, beautiful ecosystem. The future of our planet that we all depend on is shaped by the choices we make and the actions we take – every single day.
